sources.population: Pani et al., US NHANES 2001-2004 adults >=25 without self-reported diabetes and fasting plasma glucose <126 mg/dL, n3270, survey weighted; also FOS n2473 with additional study contexts. These cohorts are distinct; multiple rows within the article overlap and are not independent evidence. Target equal-cell design is not a survey replay.
sources.measurement: DCCT-standardized HbA1c percent by HPLC; fasting plasma glucose by hexokinase; BMI kg/m^2. NHANES complex-survey estimands. Mean±SE table entries are not individual SDs; prose BMI adjacent0.14 dispersion label is unresolved and unused.

sources.population: Finnish Health 2011 urban general-population subset, ages30-64, n653, weighted using sampling/nonresponse adjustments. Excluded type1/type2 diagnosis/register/medication evidence, HbA1c>=6.5% or glucose>=7 mmol/L; 4-17h fasting and complete cases. Maamu migrant groups are reported in the same article but not fitted. S1/S2 use the same Health2011 people.
sources.measurement: Standing standardized anthropometry; HbA1c immunoturbidimetry. General-population glucose measured in serum; Maamu glucose in fluoride citrate plasma. Supplement S1/S2 do not print outcome units. Model infers S1 mmol/L and S2 HbA1c percent using article Tables1/methods/intercept plausibility, not a printed unit label. Glucose analyses reportedly adjust fasting duration although displayed S1 block lists age+sex+BMI only.

sources.population: Kerman Iran proportional postal-area cluster sample, ages18-75; FBS<=126 mg/dL subgroup n525 includes30 self-reported diabetes cases. Weighting of reported analyses is not specified. No assumption of zero weights or independent simple random sampling is made.
sources.measurement: FBS once by enzyme method, mg/dL; HbA1c Biosystem kit, percent. Pearson correlation explicitly named. Printed Table2 regression scales are unresolved and not used. Source SDs are individual marginal dispersion, not SE or conditional residual spread.

sources.population: Taiwan Biobank adults30-70 without prior diabetes diagnosis, n4748, not all fasting. Methods report2563 females but Results/tables2565; no effect of this unresolved count typo is inferred. Analysis weighting is not explicitly reported; no matching target fasting-glucose exclusion.
sources.measurement: Venous EDTA HbA1c percent; some samples nonfasting. Age/sex regressions lack BMI and fasting-glucose adjustment. HbA1c<6.5 subgroup estimates are selection-dependent.
